title: Egg Fried Rice
subtitle: Classic Chinese stir-fried rice with egg and vegetables
excerpt: Egg fried rice is one of the most practical dishes in Chinese cooking. Day-old rice is stir-fried in a screaming-hot pan with beaten egg, vegetables, and soy sauce. It is ready in 10 minutes and is the ideal way to use up leftover rice. Every household has its own version.
sourceNotes: Egg fried rice is one of the most versatile dishes in Chinese cooking. It is the classic way to use leftover cooked rice, which fries better when dry and cold. The technique of coating the rice in egg and tossing it in a screaming-hot wok is fundamental to Chinese home cooking.

content.text: The single most important rule for egg fried rice is to use cold, day-old rice. Freshly cooked rice holds too much moisture and turns to mush in the pan. Spread leftover rice on a tray and refrigerate it uncovered if you are planning this dish. High heat is the other key -- the hotter the pan, the better the result.

items.prepNote: cooked and cooled -- day-old rice works best

content.text: Heat a wok or large frying pan over the highest heat possible. Add 2 tablespoons of oil.
Add the garlic and diced carrot. Stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the cold rice. Break up any clumps with the back of a spoon. Stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes until the rice is hot and starting to crisp slightly.
Push the rice to the sides. Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the centre. Pour in the beaten eggs. Scramble quickly until just set, then toss with the rice.
Add the peas, soy sauce, and spring onion. Toss everything together for 1 minute. Season with salt.

items.cause: Rice too wet or freshly cooked
items.fix: Use day-old rice that has been stored uncovered in the fridge -- it dries out and separates much better. If using fresh rice, spread it on a tray and chill for at least 2 hours before frying.

content.text: Egg fried rice is one of the most practical dishes in Chinese cooking. It transforms leftover rice into something better. Street vendors in China fry it in massive woks over roaring gas flames. At home, the hottest possible hob gives the closest result. Every household has its own variation.
